Abstract.AbstractText: In an agreement test between two raters with binary endpoints, existing methods for sample size calculation are always based on asymptotic approaches that use limiting distributions of a test statistic under null and alternative hypotheses. These calculated sample sizes may be not reliable due to the unsatisfactory type I error control of asymptotic approaches. We propose a new sample size calculation based on exact approaches which control for the type I error rate. The two exact approaches are considered: one approach based on maximization and the other based on estimation and maximization. We found that the latter approach is generally more powerful than the one based on maximization. Therefore, we present the sample size calculation based on estimation and maximization. A real example from a clinical trial to diagnose low back pain of patients is used to illustrate the two exact testing procedures and sample size determination.
